stoneboundSoles.name: Stonebound Soles
stoneboundSoles.description: Ancestral weight, deep-road memory, and the old bond between dwarven bodies and stone.
stoneboundSoles.restriction: A dwarf with Stonebound Soles cannot wear another Feet Artifact, magical boots, hooves, talons, or similar Feet-based Artifact.

baseValues.label: Tremorsense
baseValues.note: Ground-contact detection within 4–16 m.

baseValues.label: Armor (Feet)
baseValues.note: +1 to +4 Armor at higher levels.

levelProgression.name: Anchoring Stance I
levelProgression.effect: You become Immovable and gain 40 Temporary HP.

levelProgression.name: Stone-Sure Step I
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 8 m along a legal ground path. This movement does not provoke movement-triggered Reactions.

levelProgression.name: Stoneweave Guard I
levelProgression.effect: When you activate an Active Buff that grants Armor, you may increase that Buff's effective Power Level by +1 and its duration by +1 round (cannot exceed PL 16). Uses per Safe Haven Rest: half MR, rounded up.

levelProgression.name: Anchoring Stance II
levelProgression.effect: You become Immovable and gain 220 Temporary HP.

levelProgression.name: Stone-Sure Step II
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 14 m along a legal ground path. This movement does not provoke movement-triggered Reactions.

levelProgression.name: Stoneweave Guard II
levelProgression.effect: When you activate an Active Buff that grants Armor, you may increase its Power Level by +2 and duration by +2 rounds (cannot exceed PL 16).

levelProgression.name: Anchoring Stance III
levelProgression.effect: You become Immovable and gain 400 Temporary HP.

levelProgression.name: Stone-Sure Step III
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 20 m along a legal ground path. This movement does not provoke movement-triggered Reactions.

levelProgression.name: Stoneweave Guard III
levelProgression.effect: When you activate an Active Buff that grants Armor, you may increase its Power Level by +3 and duration by +3 rounds (cannot exceed PL 16).

levelProgression.name: True Stonebound Soles
levelProgression.effect: Stonebound Soles fully awaken. Choose or define one final Tremorsense, Armor, Immovable, Safe Movement, or stone defense effect with GM approval.

elorianStride.name: Elorian Stride
elorianStride.description: Elorian Stride is an Elorian Echo Artifact representing otherworldly balance, reflex, clinging movement and focus in combat.
elorianStride.restriction: An Elorian with Elorian Stride cannot wear another Feet Artifact, magical boots, hooves, talons, or similar Feet-based Artifact. Elorian Stride is Echo-bound and cannot normally be removed, replaced, sold, stolen, or unbound.

baseValues.label: Evade
baseValues.note: +2 to +12 Evade across levels; Level 10 grants True Elorian Stride.

baseValues.label: Movement
baseValues.note: +1 to +4 m Movement from Level 4 onward.

levelProgression.name: Otherworld Reflex I
levelProgression.effect: Gain +4 Evade against the triggering attack.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Cling I
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 10 m along walls, ceilings, or similar solid surfaces.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Focus I
levelProgression.effect: Supports the Agility Ability: Crit Stone Power and pre-fills Tier 3. You must still pay Tier 2 yourself. If Tier 2 is not paid, the pre-filled Tier 3 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Otherworld Reflex II
levelProgression.effect: Gain +8 Evade against the triggering attack.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Cling II
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 25 m along walls, ceilings, or similar solid surfaces.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Focus II
levelProgression.effect: Supports the Agility Ability: Crit Stone Power and pre-fills Tier 4. You must still pay Tiers 2, 3 yourself. If Tiers 2, 3 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 4 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Otherworld Reflex III
levelProgression.effect: Gain +12 Evade against the triggering attack.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Cling III
levelProgression.effect: Move up to 28 m along walls, ceilings, or similar solid surfaces.

levelProgression.name: Elorian Focus III
levelProgression.effect: Supports the Agility Ability: Crit Stone Power and pre-fills Tier 5. You must still pay Tiers 2, 3, 4 yourself. If Tiers 2, 3, 4 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 5 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: True Elorian Stride
levelProgression.effect: Elorian Stride fully awakens. Choose or define one final movement, reflex, clinging, focus, or agility effect with GM approval.

titanScarsMight.name: Titan Scars
titanScarsMight.description: Ancient scars, stone-like tissue, Titan blood, and broken divine bindings grown into the body.
titanScarsMight.restriction: A Titanborn with Titan Scars cannot wear mundane armor or bind another Body Artifact. Titan Scars are Echo-bound and cannot normally be removed, replaced, sold, stolen, unequipped, or unbound.

baseValues.label: Medium Armor
baseValues.note: +12 to +22 Armor; counts as Medium Armor (Evade −2, Initiative −4, −1d8 Physical).

levelProgression.name: Titan Growth I
levelProgression.effect: Activate Titan Growth (Active Buff: Armor + Temporary HP) at Power Level 4. Uses your maintained Active Buff slot.

levelProgression.name: Titan Might Pool I
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Titan Scars gift you 2 Might Stones.

levelProgression.name: Titan Regeneration I
levelProgression.effect: Activate Titan Regeneration (Active Buff: Healing) at Power Level 4. Uses your maintained Active Buff slot.

levelProgression.name: Titan Growth II
levelProgression.effect: Titan Growth improves to Power Level 10.

levelProgression.name: Titan Might Pool II
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Titan Scars gift you 4 Might Stones.

levelProgression.name: Titan Regeneration II
levelProgression.effect: Titan Regeneration improves to Power Level 10.

levelProgression.name: Titan Growth III
levelProgression.effect: Titan Growth improves to Power Level 16.

levelProgression.name: Titan Might Pool III
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Titan Scars gift you 8 Might Stones.

levelProgression.name: Titan Regeneration III
levelProgression.effect: Titan Regeneration improves to Power Level 16.

levelProgression.name: True Titan Scars
levelProgression.effect: Once per Safe Haven Rest, you may have both Titan Growth and Titan Regeneration active at once without either occupying your maintained Active Buff slot, until the end of your next turn.

wyrmScalesHeavy.name: Wyrm Scales (Heavy)
wyrmScalesHeavy.description: The heaviest Dragonborn scale-form — maximum armor, heavy class drawbacks.
wyrmScalesHeavy.restriction: A Dragonborn with Wyrm Scales cannot wear mundane armor or another Body Artifact.

baseValues.label: Heavy Echo Armor
baseValues.note: Heavy Armor base + artifact bonus; Evade −4, Initiative −8, −2d8 Physical Skills.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings I
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 6 m.

levelProgression.name: Wyrm Scales I
levelProgression.effect: You gain +13 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Armor Stone Support I
levelProgression.effect: Wyrm Scales support the Vitality Ability ARMOR Stone Power and pre-fill Tier 2. You must still pay Tier 1 yourself. If Tier 1 is not paid, the pre-filled Tier 2 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings II
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 15 m.

levelProgression.name: Wyrm Scales II
levelProgression.effect: You gain +31 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Armor Stone Support II
levelProgression.effect: Wyrm Scales pre-fill Tier 3 of the Vitality Ability ARMOR Stone Power. You must still pay Tier 1 and Tier 2 yourself. If Tier 1 and Tier 2 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 3 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings III
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 24 m.

levelProgression.name: Wyrm Scales III
levelProgression.effect: You gain +49 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Armor Stone Support III
levelProgression.effect: Wyrm Scales pre-fill Tier 4 of the Vitality Ability ARMOR Stone Power. You must still pay Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 yourself. If Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 4 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Transformation
levelProgression.effect: You unlock your Wyrm Dragon Form. Choose the shape of this form when this Artifact reaches Level 10. The form occupies a large space, uses the transformation rules below, and grants the listed Dragon Form benefits.

wyrmScalesLight.name: Serpent Scales
wyrmScalesLight.description: Light serpent scale-form — evasion, mobility, and aerial grace over raw soak.
wyrmScalesLight.restriction: A Dragonborn with Wyrm Scales cannot wear mundane armor or another Body Artifact.

baseValues.label: Light Echo Armor
baseValues.note: Light Armor base + artifact bonus; no armor-class drawbacks.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings I
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 6 m.

levelProgression.name: Serpent Evasion I
levelProgression.effect: You gain +6 Evade.

levelProgression.name: Evasion Stone Support I
levelProgression.effect: Serpent Scales support the Agility Ability EVADE Stone Power and pre-fill Tier 2. You must still pay Tier 1 yourself. If Tier 1 is not paid, the pre-filled Tier 2 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings II
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 15 m.

levelProgression.name: Mobility Buff Extension II
levelProgression.effect: Whenever you activate an Active Buff that grants Evade or Movement as one of its effects, increase that Buff's duration by +2 rounds. This does not increase the Buff's value. This does not allow you to maintain a second Active Buff.

levelProgression.name: Evasion Stone Support II
levelProgression.effect: Serpent Scales pre-fill Tier 3 of the Agility Ability EVADE Stone Power. You must still pay Tier 1 and Tier 2 yourself. If Tier 1 and Tier 2 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 3 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: Dragon Wings III
levelProgression.effect: You may fly up to 24 m.

levelProgression.name: Mobility Buff Extension III
levelProgression.effect: Whenever you activate an Active Buff that grants Evade or Movement as one of its effects, increase that Buff's duration by +3 rounds. This does not increase the Buff's value. This does not allow you to maintain a second Active Buff.

levelProgression.name: Evasion Stone Support III
levelProgression.effect: Serpent Scales pre-fill Tier 4 of the Agility Ability EVADE Stone Power. You must still pay Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 yourself. If Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 are not paid, the pre-filled Tier 4 has no effect.

levelProgression.name: True Serpent Form
levelProgression.effect: Your body becomes perfectly adapted to motion. Choose or define one final mobility, evasion, or light-dragon transformation effect with GM approval.

dragonClaws.name: Dragon Claws
dragonClaws.description: Both hands become natural weapons: claws, scales, and tail.
dragonClaws.restriction: A Dragonborn with Dragon Claws cannot wield another weapon, shield, or hand-based Artifact while using them. Occupies both hand slots.

baseValues.label: Claw / Tail Damage
baseValues.note: 5d8 to 14d8 across levels (4d8 two-handed base + 1d8/level).

baseValues.label: Weapon Special
baseValues.note: Penetration scaling from L4.

baseValues.label: Weapon Special
baseValues.note: Brutal Impact scaling from L7.

levelProgression.name: Extra Damage Support I
levelProgression.effect: Dragon Claws support the Might Ability Melee Damage Stone Power. They pre-fill Tier 2. You must still pay Tier 1 yourself.

levelProgression.name: Rending Spiral I
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take your current Claw / Tail Weapon Damage.

levelProgression.name: Tail Sweep I
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take Claw / Tail Damage and are pushed 2 m.

levelProgression.name: Extra Damage Support II
levelProgression.effect: Dragon Claws support the Might Ability Melee Damage Stone Power. They pre-fill Tier 3. You must still pay Tier 1 and 2 yourself.

levelProgression.name: Rending Spiral II
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take Claw / Tail Damage.

levelProgression.name: Tail Sweep II
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take Claw / Tail Damage and are pushed 6 m.

levelProgression.name: Extra Damage Support III
levelProgression.effect: Dragon Claws support the Might Ability Melee Damage Stone Power. They pre-fill Tier 4. You must still pay Tier 1, 2 and 3 yourself.

levelProgression.name: Rending Spiral III
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take Claw / Tail Damage.

levelProgression.name: Tail Sweep III
levelProgression.effect: Affected creatures take Claw / Tail Damage and are pushed 10 m.

levelProgression.name: True Dragon Claws
levelProgression.effect: Dragon Claws fully awaken. Choose or define one final Claw or Tail effect.

dragonHead.name: Dragon Head
dragonHead.description: A draconic head: a scaling Bite weapon, a Breath Weapon, the Draconic Roar armor aura, and stone-refreshing Draconic Recovery. Pick a Breath Shape and a Breath Special when the artifact is created.
dragonHead.restriction: A Dragonborn with Dragon Head cannot wear another Head Artifact, helmet, mask, crown, or magical headgear.

baseValues.label: Bite Weapon Damage
baseValues.note: 1d8 to 10d8 across levels.

baseValues.label: Scent of Blood
baseValues.note: Detect from L4, Locate from L7, Identify at L10.

levelProgression.name: Breath Weapon I
levelProgression.effect: Bite Damage + 8d8 damage to affected creatures.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Roar I
levelProgression.effect: You and allies in the area gain +12 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Recovery I
levelProgression.effect: Restore 1 spent Stone of the chosen Attribute.

levelProgression.name: Breath Weapon II
levelProgression.effect: Bite Damage + 16d8 damage to affected creatures.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Roar II
levelProgression.effect: You and allies in the area gain +28 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Recovery II
levelProgression.effect: Restore 2 spent Stones of the chosen Attribute.

levelProgression.name: Breath Weapon III
levelProgression.effect: Bite Damage + 24d8 damage to affected creatures.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Roar III
levelProgression.effect: You and allies in the area gain +44 Armor.

levelProgression.name: Draconic Recovery III
levelProgression.effect: Restore 4 spent Stones of the chosen Attribute.

levelProgression.name: True Dragon Head
levelProgression.effect: Choose or define one final Breath, Bite, Roar, Recovery, or Head effect with GM approval.

sentinelFrame.name: Sentinel Frame
sentinelFrame.description: The armored enforcer frame — an iron wall of heavenly order.
sentinelFrame.restriction: A character with a Sentinel Body Artifact cannot wear mundane armor or bind another Body Artifact.

baseValues.label: Light Echo Armor
baseValues.note: +8 to +18 Armor; no Light Armor drawback.

levelProgression.name: Single Heal I
levelProgression.effect: Use a single-target healing Active at Power Level 4.

levelProgression.name: Resolve Core I
levelProgression.effect: Sentinel Frame gains a Resolve Stone Battery (capacity 10).

levelProgression.name: Healing Support I
levelProgression.effect: Sentinel Frame supports the Resolve Ability: Healing Stone Power and pre-fills Tier 2.

levelProgression.name: Single Heal II
levelProgression.effect: Single Heal improves to Power Level 10.

levelProgression.name: Resolve Core II
levelProgression.effect: Resolve Stone Battery capacity increases to 20.

levelProgression.name: Healing Support II
levelProgression.effect: Sentinel Frame pre-fills Tier 3 of the Resolve Ability: Healing Stone Power.

levelProgression.name: Single Heal III
levelProgression.effect: Single Heal improves to Power Level 16.

levelProgression.name: Resolve Core III
levelProgression.effect: Resolve Stone Battery capacity increases to 40.

levelProgression.name: Healing Support III
levelProgression.effect: Sentinel Frame pre-fills Tier 4 of the Resolve Ability: Healing Stone Power.

levelProgression.name: True Sentinel Frame
levelProgression.effect: Once per Safe Haven Rest, when you use Healing through Sentinel Frame, treat one required lower Tier as already paid.

judicatorFrame.name: Judicator Frame
judicatorFrame.description: A judge, inquisitor, and divine executioner frame.
judicatorFrame.restriction: A character with a Sentinel Body Artifact cannot wear mundane armor or bind another Body Artifact.

baseValues.label: Light Echo Armor
baseValues.note: +8 to +18 Armor; no Light Armor drawback.

levelProgression.name: Armor Hasten I
levelProgression.effect: When activating an Active Buff that grants Armor, empower it by +1 Power Level and +1 round (cannot exceed PL 16).

levelProgression.name: Wits Core I
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Judicator Frame stores 2 Wits Stones.

levelProgression.name: Regeneration Support I
levelProgression.effect: Judicator Frame supports the Regeneration Stone Power and pre-fills Tier 2.

levelProgression.name: Armor Hasten II
levelProgression.effect: Armor Buff Empowerment improves to +2 PL and +2 rounds.

levelProgression.name: Wits Core II
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Judicator Frame stores 4 Wits Stones.

levelProgression.name: Regeneration Support II
levelProgression.effect: Pre-fills Tier 3 of the Regeneration Stone Power.

levelProgression.name: Armor Hasten III
levelProgression.effect: Armor Buff Empowerment improves to +3 PL and +3 rounds.

levelProgression.name: Wits Core III
levelProgression.effect: After each Safe Haven Rest, Judicator Frame stores 8 Wits Stones.

levelProgression.name: Regeneration Support III
levelProgression.effect: Pre-fills Tier 4 of the Regeneration Stone Power.

levelProgression.name: True Judicator Frame
levelProgression.effect: Once per Safe Haven Rest, when activating an Armor Active Buff through Armor Hasten, you may also use the supported Regeneration Stone Power as part of the same activation.

oracleFrame.name: Oracle Frame
oracleFrame.description: An arcane vessel of command, prophecy, and divine will.
oracleFrame.restriction: A character with a Sentinel Body Artifact cannot wear mundane armor or bind another Body Artifact.
